[EN] Need to Know
[ES] Necesidad de saber
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Will do.
[ES] Así lo haré.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Who is Dakuryon disguised as?"
[ES] "¿De quién está disfrazado Dakuryon?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Read Oriyn's Will.
[ES] Lee el testamento de Oriyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "If I don't, who else?"
[ES] "Si no lo hago yo, ¿quién más?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter the Vault of Oriyn through {@linkcreature:183#1100#Oriyn's Will} and read Oriyn's Arcana.
[ES] Entra en la Bóveda de Oriyn a través de {@linkcreature:183#1100#Oriyn's Will} y lee el Arcano de Oriyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Oriyn's Glyph
[ES] Glifo de Oriyn
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter the Vault of Oriyn through {@linkcreature:183#1100#Oriyn's Will} and pass Oriyn's trial.
[ES] Entra en la Bóveda de Oriyn a través de {@linkcreature:183#1100#Oriyn's Will} y supera la prueba de Oriyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Show Oriyn's Glyph to Verikam.
[ES] Muéstrale el glifo de Oriyn a Verikam.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Just this glyph..."
[ES] "Solo este glifo..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I...I think it means you, Verikam."
[ES] "Yo... Yo creo que te refieres a ti, Verikam."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Verikam to translate the glyph.
[ES] Pídele a Verikam que traduzca el glifo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can't deal with you when you're...like this..."
[ES] "No puedo lidiar contigo cuando estás... así..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Rhodos what happened to Madat.
[ES] Pregúntale a Rhodos qué le pasó a Madat.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll talk to Dougal."
[ES] "Hablaré con Dougal."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Zolyn.
[ES] Habla con Zolyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
